meta.name: Phosphor Operations Terminal
meta.description: A bilingual DevOps portfolio rebuilt as a responsive CRT operations console around the exact ThreeUI terminal renderer and its authored Zion boot sequence.

primary.role: primary phosphor text, active commands, focus, and successful system state

secondary.role: dim terminal copy, metadata, inactive routes, and secondary telemetry

accent.role: alerts, highlighted boot results, section counters, and exceptional state

neutral.usage: Near-white mint is reserved for dominant headings; phosphor green carries body and state; deep green-black surfaces preserve tube contrast.

color.contrast_strategy: High-contrast mint and green glyphs on nearly black green surfaces, with amber used sparingly and never as the sole status cue.

font_families.heading: Roboto Mono, ui-monospace, monospace
font_families.mono: ThreeUI Fragment Mono, ui-monospace, SF Mono, JetBrains Mono, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

typography.font_style_notes: A Vietnamese-capable Roboto Mono application shell surrounds the renderer's authored system monospace stack; scale and phosphor intensity create hierarchy.

spacing.section_rhythm: Dense command metadata sits inside generous record-to-record pauses; panels use 1px gaps like adjacent terminal cells.

layout.grid_system: Twelve-column terminal record grid with a two-pane hero console
layout.alignment_tendency: Strict ruled grid with asymmetric hero panes and stacked mobile records

shape.border_usage: One-pixel phosphor rules define every command panel; no decorative rounding outside the shader's authored tube curvature.
shape.divider_style: Dim green hairline that brightens to full phosphor for active or focused state

elevation.shadow_style: Deep black occlusion with low-intensity phosphor halation
elevation.depth_cues: Curved shader glass, inner bezel shadow, glyph halation, ruled foreground panels, and layered scan/grille texture

iconography.preferred_set: Existing custom inline SVG system icons

motion.entrance_pattern: Command records resolve upward after the authored CRT boot begins typing
motion.exit_pattern: Opacity decay with shallow vertical displacement
motion.philosophy: Analogue terminal motion led by typewriter cadence, scan drift, flicker, and restrained GSAP record reveals

components.button_style: Square bracketed terminal commands; solid phosphor primary and ruled dark secondary
components.input_style: Black-green command field with one-pixel phosphor focus inset
components.card_style: Square record pane with dark-green gradient, status readout, thin grid rule, and no conventional card shadow
components.navigation_pattern: Sticky command header with slash-prefixed routes, language state, theme mode, search, and repository channel
components.modal_style: Full-height command search console with hard rules, black scrim, and phosphor focus
components.list_style: Numbered or plus-prefixed evidence rows separated by dim raster rules
components.component_notes: CrtBackground remains source-identical; all surrounding application components inherit its phosphor palette, square geometry, and terminal metadata grammar.

aesthetic.visual_metaphor: A secure operations terminal booting into an engineer's verified system records
aesthetic.era_influence: Late-20th-century curved CRT consoles interpreted through contemporary responsive engineering UI

visual_language.whitespace_usage: Large record gaps offset compact diagnostic labels
visual_language.visual_weight_distribution: A bright curved CRT pane balances a dense command-copy pane, followed by evenly ruled evidence surfaces
visual_language.focal_strategy: Exact boot terminal first, engineering identity second, progressively disclosed evidence afterward
visual_language.texture_usage: Scanlines, RGB grille, phosphor halo, grain, vignette, black-green grid, and blinking caret

composition.hierarchy_method: Phosphor intensity, type scale, command prefixes, and strict border grouping
composition.flow_direction: Boot sequence to identity prompt to system records to open communication channel
composition.grouping_strategy: Terminal panes, record headers, status rails, evidence tables, and command actions
composition.negative_space_role: Separates system records and protects readability from the continuous raster texture

imagery.photo_treatment: Company marks are monochrome and phosphor-graded; decorative photography is absent
imagery.illustration_style: Technical architecture diagrams treated as terminal schematics
imagery.graphic_elements: Curved CRT glass, blinking block cursor, slash routes, bracket commands, status lamps, scan grille, and 1px rules
imagery.pattern_usage: Low-opacity 4rem terminal grid beneath a fixed scanline overlay
imagery.image_shape: Square, ruled system viewports without rounded card shells

interaction_feel.feedback_style: Immediate phosphor border, color, and 1-2px movement response
interaction_feel.hover_behavior: Border reaches full phosphor, inner green glow rises, and records lift no more than 2px
interaction_feel.transition_personality: Snappy terminal resolve with smooth macro scroll choreography
interaction_feel.loading_style: Authored 19-row Zion boot log types character by character with a blinking block caret

brand_voice_in_ui.tone: Direct, diagnostic, technically credible, and evidence-led
brand_voice_in_ui.empty_state_approach: Print the next valid command and its expected result
brand_voice_in_ui.error_tone: Specific fault, affected boundary, and recovery command

overview.fallback_strategy: Semantic portfolio content remains independent of the decorative shader; CSS surfaces and terminal contrast remain when the CRT pane is unavailable.
overview.primary_technology: Raw WebGL + offscreen Canvas 2D with GSAP supporting motion

background_effects.description: A curved green-phosphor CRT composites an authored 19-row Zion boot screen through scan, grille, chroma, halation, flicker, grain, sheen, and vignette passes.
background_effects.technology: Raw WebGL fragment shader over an uploaded Canvas 2D text texture

params.density: Full backing resolution up to 1920px width and 2,400,000 pixels
params.blend_mode: Opaque WebGL composite with shader-level phosphor halation

particle_systems.description: The CRT design uses raster noise and glyph halation instead of particles.

3d_elements.description: Tube depth is simulated in the fragment shader rather than with a 3D scene.

params.lighting: shader sheen and phosphor halo only

shader_effects.description: The exact ThreeUI CRT fragment shader curves UVs, offsets RGB channels, applies a six-tap halo, scanlines, grille, rolling bar, flicker, vignette, grain, room spill, and edge falloff.

params.vertex_manipulation: One fullscreen triangle; CRT curvature is applied to fragment UV coordinates
params.fragment_output: Opaque curved tube composite with green phosphor glyphs, amber boot results, scan structure, RGB grille, halo, vignette, and room spill
params.noise_type: deterministic hash grain; analogue noise disabled for terminal variant
params.distortion: terminal curve [0.115, 0.165], chroma 1, scan depth 0.30, grille 0.34

parallax.speed_curve: GSAP scrub 0.65 for the desktop CRT pane and copy

scroll_triggered_animations.trigger_points: desktop hero pinned above 62rem; records enter near 88% viewport
scroll_triggered_animations.animation_type: masked word reveal, terminal pane scale, record fade-up, architecture path draw

scroll_morphing.description: The desktop command view pins briefly while the CRT pane advances and the identity pane dims into the technology rail.

text_effects.description: The exact renderer reveals 4.4 glyph units per frame step at typeSpeed 1.00 while the portfolio headline resolves by masked words.

params.split_strategy: authored terminal by character; semantic headline by word
params.animation_per_unit: Canvas reveal counter and translateY 115% rotateX -28deg
params.stagger: 42ms maximum text redraw; 45ms headline word stagger
params.effect_style: phosphor typewriter with crisp glyph core and soft halo

cursor_effects.description: Primary command buttons move subtly toward a fine pointer while the terminal renderer remains non-interactive.

image_effects.description: Architecture diagrams receive a green terminal grade and shallow project-card depth.

params.filter_pipeline: reduced saturation plus green hue rotation

canvas_drawings.description: An offscreen full-backing-resolution Canvas 2D draws the authored 19-row log, double-pass glyph halo/core, and blinking caret before texture upload.

params.draw_method: two passes per glyph, soft phosphor shadow then crisp core
params.color_scheme: green phosphor with amber OK/READY results
params.responsiveness: ResizeObserver, DPR capped at 2, 1920px width and 2.4MP ceiling

svg_animations.description: Existing architecture routes draw once when their system record enters the viewport.

visual_effects.composite_notes: All five registered ThreeUI source files are stored byte-for-byte with their published SHA-256 values. The exact terminal configuration uses speed, typeSpeed, motion, brightness, saturation, and opacity at 1.00 with hue 0. The font asset referenced by the registered shared CSS was recovered from the live ThreeUI stylesheet without modifying its relative path. Application CSS is layered after the registered stylesheet so the component source and its authored render remain untouched.
